purpose: Provide one executable planning seam shared by P04 and P05 that separates host execution runtime from provider/external access, preserves sanitized inherited evidence, and prevents already-completed current-runtime work from being re-planned as local work.

capability_facts.rule: At most one hard host requirement may be true. Conflicting hard requirements mean the work unit is not atomic and must be split before placement.

provider_access_record.rule: Provider access is composable metadata and never substitutes for host execution environment.

rules: Tracked evidence may not require a raw private provider URL or identifier.
PROTECTED_EXTERNAL evidence must use an opaque tracked alias and keep the private identity in protected provider transport.
Freshness/revision and proof ceiling travel with the evidence reference.

placement_precedence: CURRENT_CHAT_RUNTIME when current_runtime_available and current_runtime_authorized are both true.
execution_rule: CURRENT_CHAT_RUNTIME is executable-now only when both current_runtime_available and current_runtime_authorized are true. All other host placements are handoffs or blocked/owner-resolution states for the active chat.

projection_rules.P04: Partition before dependency graph and adapter selection; emit placement after LAUNCH ORDER and preserve the typed fields in the dispatch manifest.
projection_rules.P05: Partition before ordered pack construction; LAUNCH ORDER remains first; already-completed current-runtime work becomes inherited evidence rather than a fake successor sprint.

privacy_rules: Reject tracked evidence refs containing raw http(s) URLs when visibility is PROTECTED_EXTERNAL.
Reject obvious Google Drive/Docs URL fragments in PROTECTED_EXTERNAL tracked refs.
Use opaque aliases such as opaque:prompt-scratch/live-workbook for protected external identities.
proof_ceiling: Prototype/static contract. It proves deterministic placement and projection semantics only; it does not prove provider authentication, prompt-model obedience, local runner availability, or live dispatch.
